questions.title: Manual String Length
questions.description:
The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    int my_strlen(const char *s)

It must return the number of characters before the terminating '\0' — by walking the string yourself, WITHOUT calling strlen.

Input Format:
One line with a single token (the string).

Output Format:
One line with its length.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, the token contains no whitespace
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length <= 1000, the token contains no whitespace

questions.title: Word Ordering Check

questions.title: Caesar Cipher Shift
questions.description:
A puzzle club encodes messages with a Caesar shift: every letter moves k positions forward in its alphabet (wrapping a->z), case is preserved, non-letters stay unchanged. k may exceed 26; reduce it modulo 26.

The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    void caesar(char *s, int k)

It must shift s in place. The harness prints the encoded token.

Input Format:
Line 1: the message (single token). Line 2: the shift k.

Output Format:
One line with the encoded message.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000, the token contains no whitespace
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length <= 1000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000, the token contains no whitespace
